text:
Type: tall single-door glass vitrine
Use: displaying glassware, china or collections, closed storage below; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: black-stained wood with visible grain, clear glass door and sides, glass shelves, small brass knob
Colors: black-brown, clear glass, brass
Shape: tall narrow cabinet with a stepped crown molding, glazed door over a solid lower panel, glass side panels, plinth base, slim and stately
Feel: elegant, formal, rich, timeless
Goes with: white or cream walls, brass, crystal, patterned rugs; traditional or classic dining rooms and living rooms

product.name: MALSJ
product.description: The glass shelves are adjustable so you can customise your storage as needed.
